title: Vodafone Search
thumbnailAlt: Vodafone home screen introducing the redesigned in-app search experience
seoDescription: Vodafone Search: an in-app search redesign that introduces more categories, especially Shop, responds while typing, and supports personalization.
deck: Bringing more categories into search, with a response as people type.

blocks.heading: Making room for the shop.
blocks.body:
The brief was to improve in-app search and introduce more categories, especially Shop. Customers needed a clear way to explore an expanded set of services and products.

I owned the search placement, category tabs, and the number of suggestions and previews shown at each step. Competitor reviews and familiar search patterns informed those choices.

**Designed and prototyped; not yet shipped.**

blocks.heading: Search that responds.
blocks.body:
The previous search was static and did not show results while people searched. The redesign responds with suggestions and relevant results, and supports personalization.

I also moved the search bar to the top, making it the first place to start.

blocks.beforeAlt: Ana Vodafone search screen before the redesign.
blocks.afterAlt: Redesigned Ana Vodafone search screen with recent searches below the top search field.

blocks.heading: How much is too much?
blocks.body: I kept each preview short so people can scan it and choose where to explore. These counts are design choices informed by competitor reviews and cognitive-load principles, not measured results.

items.detail: Recent and trending searches across no more than two rows.
The preferred suggestion limit while the keyboard is open.
A short preview, with the full category a tap away.
Product previews, with a route to the full list.

blocks.heading: Finding the right aisle.
blocks.body: I kept an All view for mixed results and added category tabs for a more focused list. Short previews let people compare groups; “See all” opens the full category.

blocks.heading: Put search to work.
blocks.title: Ana Vodafone search prototype
blocks.body: Try a search, explore the suggestions, and switch between result categories.

blocks.heading: Can people find it faster?
blocks.body:
**Illustrative target: 20% lower median time to reach the right result.** This is a proposed goal, not a measured improvement; there is no baseline yet.

Test service and shopping tasks, measuring completion as well as time.
